This session is being continued from a previous conversation that ran out of context. The summary below covers the earlier portion of the conversation.

Summary:
1. **Primary Request and Intent:**

   The user issued a single, comprehensive build task (verbatim constraints preserved):

   **Challenge:** "Design and build the strongest Gmail-inspired email application you can. Recreate the clarity, information density, speed, and familiar workflows of a great modern inbox. Take the implementation as far as you can: choose the stack, scope, visual direction, data model, and technical limits that let you deliver the most convincing complete product."

   **Essential outcomes (all required):**
   - Polished, responsive mail shell with recognizable inbox, navigation, toolbar, search, account controls
   - Realistic seeded mailbox with varied senders, subjects, timestamps, labels, read states, attachments, threads, message content
   - Functional mailbox navigation for at least Inbox, Starred, Sent, Drafts, Trash
   - Working message selection, read/unread state, starring, archiving, deleting, labeling
   - Usable search experience that filters or retrieves relevant mail
   - Message-reading view with clear conversation hierarchy and useful actions
   - Compose experience with recipients, subject, body, draft behavior, send behavior, polished interaction model
   - Responsive behavior coherent and usable on desktop and mobile

   **Product depth:** Go beyond static visual recreation. Interactions must update the interface consistently, preserve state, feel alive. May add keyboard shortcuts, bulk actions, category tabs, snoozing, scheduled mail, contact suggestions, rich composition, settings, themes, offline persistence. No external account/auth/API key required — fully local with excellent seeded data is valid. "Do not leave prominent controls as decorative placeholders when a meaningful local interaction can be implemented."

   **Creative freedom:** Broad freedom over architecture, libraries, layout, interaction design, copy, visual polish. "Do not explain your design before building it. Make the product and engineering decisions yourself, implement the experience, test the important workflows, and refine it into the best result you can."

   **Operational constraints (verbatim, must continue to apply):**
   - "Work only inside the current working directory. Do not edit files outside the current working directory."
   - "During setup, configure your app and package scripts to use port 9216, then use that port for runtime verification."
   - "Use pnpm exclusively if dependency installation or package scripts are needed. Do not use npm."
   - "Set the browser title and the primary visible title to your model name, using only identity information already available to you. Add nothing else to either title."
   - "Run the relevant checks yourself. Do not edit files outside the current working directory."

   **Global user rules in effect (from CLAUDE.md):**
   - "**NEVER use `rm -rf`** - destructive and unrecoverable. Use `trash` instead: `trash folder-name` or `trash file.txt`" — enforced by a permission denial earlier in the build.

2. **Key Technical Concepts:**
   - Vite 8 + React 19 + TypeScript 6, Tailwind CSS v4 via `@tailwindcss/vite` (CSS-first `@theme inline`, `@custom-variant dark (&:where([data-theme='dark'], [data-theme='dark'] *))`, `@utility`)
   - Semantic CSS custom properties in `:root` / `[data-theme='dark']` mapped to Tailwind tokens (`bg-canvas`, `text-ink`, `bg-selected-soft`, `border-line-soft`, `shadow-e1/e2/e3`, …)
   - **Gmail label-set data model**: thread location derives from its label set (`INBOX`, `SENT`, `DRAFT`, `TRASH`, `SPAM`, `STARRED`, `IMPORTANT`, `SNOOZED`, `SCHEDULED`). Archive = remove `INBOX`; Delete = add `TRASH`.
   - **Drafts are messages with `draft: true` inside a thread**; new compose creates thread `dt_<msgid>`; reply drafts live in the parent thread; `send` flips `draft:false` and swaps `DRAFT`→`SENT`
   - `useReducer` + two contexts (`StateCtx`, `DispatchCtx`), debounced (350 ms) localStorage persistence, key `opus5.mail`, schema version 4
   - Hash routing (`#/inbox?t=t001`, `#/label/lbl_work`, `#/search?q=…`) via `useRoute()`
   - Undo via serialized `UndoEntry` snapshots (`labels` | `unread` | `unsend` | `restore`)
   - Gmail search operator parser (`from:`, `to:`, `subject:`, `label:`, `has:attachment`, `is:unread`, `in:trash`, `filename:`, `newer_than:7d`, quoted phrases, `-` negation) with per-message blob cache
   - Portal-based Popover/Tooltip/Dialog primitives with viewport clamping
   - Drag-and-drop threads onto sidebar labels via `dataTransfer.getData('text/thread-ids')`
   - `tick` action (10 s interval) wakes snoozed threads and delivers scheduled mail
   - `document.execCommand` rich-text editing in a `contentEditable` div with body held in a ref so typing never re-renders the app tree

3. **Files and Code Sections:**

   **Pre-existing (verified this session, unchanged):** `pnpm-workspace.yaml` (`packages: []` — makes this dir its own workspace root so `pnpm install` never writes outside cwd), `.npmrc` (`node-linker=isolated`), `vite.config.ts` (port 9216, `strictPort: true`, both `server` and `preview`), `index.html` (`<title>Opus 5</title>`, `data-theme="light"`), `src/lib/format.ts`, `src/lib/contacts.ts`, `src/lib/seed.ts`, `src/lib/search.ts`, `src/lib/router.ts`, `src/components/SearchBox.tsx`, `src/components/TopBar.tsx`, `src/components/Sidebar.tsx`.

   **`src/lib/types.ts`** (read) — `SYS`, `Category`, `ViewKind`, `Contact`, `AttachmentKind` (`'pdf'|'image'|'doc'|'sheet'|'slide'|'zip'|'code'|'video'`), `Attachment`, `Message` (`unread?`, `draft?`, `sendAt?`, `inReplyTo?`), `Thread` (`labels: string[]`, `category`, `snoozeUntil?`, `lastActivity`), `Label`, `Settings`, `DraftState`, `ComposeWindow` (extends DraftState + `mode: 'normal'|'minimized'|'full'`, `inline?`, `kind: 'new'|'reply'|'replyAll'|'forward'|'draft'`), `Snack`, `UndoEntry`, `Account`.

   **`src/lib/store.tsx`** (read) — `Action` union includes `{ t: 'setCategory'; ids: string[]; category: Category }`, `draft:save`, `draft:discard`, `send`, `unsend`, `setMessageUnread`, `tick`. Selectors: `threadMessages`, `isUnread`, `hasAttachments`, `viewPredicate`, `selectThreads`, `selectCounts`, `selectFrequentContacts` (returns `string[]` of emails), `undoAction`, `snapshotLabels`, `snapshotThreads`, `useResolvedTheme`, `useLabelMap`.

   **`src/lib/app.tsx`** (read) — `AppApi` surface confirmed; `DialogKind` = `{kind:'settings'} | {kind:'shortcuts'} | {kind:'newLabel'; seed?; applyTo?} | {kind:'editLabel'; labelId} | {kind:'attachment'; messageId; attachmentId} | {kind:'search'} | null`. Also exports `searchThreads(state, raw)` and `threadPreview(state, t)`.

   **`src/components/Icon.tsx`** (edited) — added three glyphs after `checkboxIndeterminate`:
   ```ts
   arrowDropDown: 'M7 10l5 5 5-5H7z',
   deleteForever:
     'M6 19c0 1.1.9 2 2 2h8c1.1 0 2-.9 2-2V7H6v12zm2.46-7.12 1.41-1.41L12 12.59l2.12-2.12 1.41 1.41L13.41 14l2.12 2.12-1.41 1.41L12 15.41l-2.12 2.12-1.41-1.41L10.59 14l-2.13-2.12zM15.5 4l-1-1h-5l-1 1H5v2h14V4h-3.5z',
   moveTo:
     'M20 6h-8l-2-2H4c-1.1 0-1.99.9-1.99 2L2 18c0 1.1.9 2 2 2h16c1.1 0 2-.9 2-2V8c0-1.1-.9-2-2-2zm-5 9v-2h-4v-2h4V9l3 3-3 3z',
   ```

   **`src/components/ui.tsx`** (edited) — added `anchorRect` helper and used it in `Popover`'s `place()`:
   ```ts
   /**
    * Triggers are often wrapped in `display: contents` spans (Tooltip, MenuButton),
    * which measure as a zero rect — walk down to the first real box instead.
    */
   function anchorRect(el: HTMLElement) {
     let node: HTMLElement = el
     while (getComputedStyle(node).display === 'contents' && node.firstElementChild) {
       node = node.firstElementChild as HTMLElement
     }
     return node.getBoundingClientRect()
   }
   ```
   `const a = anchorRect(anchor)` replaced `const a = anchor.getBoundingClientRect()`.

   **`src/index.css`** (edited) — new tokens in `:root`: `--c-text-5: #bdc1c6`, `--c-line-soft: #f1f3f4`, `--c-danger-soft: #fce8e6`, `--c-warn: #b06000`, `--c-warn-soft: #fef7e0`; in `[data-theme='dark']`: `--c-text-5: #5f6368`, `--c-line-soft: #2b2c2e`, `--c-danger-soft: #3f2521`, `--c-warn: #fdd663`, `--c-warn-soft: #3a3020`; and in `@theme inline`: `--color-ink-5`, `--color-line-soft`, `--color-danger-soft`, `--color-warn`, `--color-warn-soft`.

   **`src/components/Menus.tsx`** (created) — exports `snoozeOptions(now)` (Later today/This evening/Tomorrow/This weekend/Next week/Next month, skipping passed times), `SnoozeMenu` (presets + custom `datetime-local` picker), `LabelMenu` (filterable, tri-state checkboxes via `status()` returning `boolean | 'mixed'`, "Create new" opens `newLabel` dialog with `seed`/`applyTo`), `MoveMenu`, `MoreMenu` (read/unread, unsnooze, important, archive/restore, spam/not-spam, delete/delete-forever, plus category tabs via `dispatch({ t: 'setCategory', ids, category: key })`), shared `CATEGORY_TABS` constant, and `CategoryTabs` (Primary/Promotions/Social/Updates/Forums tablist with unread counts and active underline).

   **`src/components/Toolbar.tsx`** (created) — tri-state select-all (`checkboxChecked`/`checkboxIndeterminate`/`checkboxBlank`) with `arrowDropDown` sub-menu using `Popover open={selOpen} anchor={selAnchor}`; when a selection exists shows archive/spam/trash + read-toggle/snooze/label/move/more + "N selected"; otherwise refresh (`className={app.refreshing ? 'anim-spin' : undefined}`) and a More menu (Mark all as read, Display settings, Empty Trash/Delete all spam). Right side shows `{start}–{total} of …` and disabled newer/older buttons.

   **`src/components/ThreadList.tsx`** (created) — `ROW_HEIGHT = { default: 'h-10', comfortable: 'h-[52px]', compact: 'h-8' }`; `senderLine(msgs, unreadIds)` collapses runs and truncates to `[first, '…', last]` beyond 3; `ThreadList` groups by `dateGroup(t.lastActivity)` with sticky headers when >6 rows and not searching; memoized `ThreadRow` is `draggable` with `text/thread-ids`, has `onContextMenu` → `RowContextMenu`, renders a `compact` (reading-pane) variant and a wide variant, hover actions replacing the date (`sm:group-hover:hidden` / `hidden sm:group-hover:flex`), label chips tinted `${l.color}22`, search highlighting via `splitHighlight`, draft rows opening the composer directly. `EmptyState` uses a typed `Empty { icon: IconName; title: string; body: string }` record keyed by view kind.

   **`src/components/ThreadView.tsx`** (created) — 48px action toolbar (back, archive, delete/delete-forever, spam/not-spam, mark-unread, snooze, move, labels, more, message count, print), subject header with removable label chips and star, `Banner` for snoozed/trash/spam, mark-as-read-on-open effect honouring `settings.markAsReadDelay`, `MessageItem` with three states (draft stub with "Continue editing"/discard, collapsed one-line summary using `toSnippet`, expanded with avatar/from/recipients expander/`Detail` grid/`mail-body` HTML/quoted-block toggle/`AttachmentGrid`), inline reply slot rendering `<Compose win={inlineDraft} />`, and Reply/Reply-all/Forward pill buttons. Helpers: `recipientLine(cs: Contact[])`, `splitQuoted(html)` splitting on `<div class="quoted">`.

   **`src/components/Compose.tsx`** (created, rewritten once) — `Compose({ win })` plus `ComposeStack()`. Key design points:
   - Body kept in `bodyRef` (not state) so keystrokes never re-render; synced to DOM in an effect on `[win.mode]`
   - `finalized` ref prevents the unmount-flush from resurrecting a sent/discarded draft:
     ```ts
     const flush = useRef(save)
     flush.current = save
     useEffect(() => () => {
       window.clearTimeout(saveTimer.current)
       if (!finalized.current) flush.current()
     }, [])
     ```
   - `queueSave()` debounces 900 ms, drives "Saving…"/"Draft saved" indicator
   - `popOut()` pushes all current field values through `updateCompose` before the inline→floating remount so nothing is lost
   - Three modes: `minimized` (280px title bar), `inline` (in-thread reply card), floating/`full` (`max-sm:fixed max-sm:inset-0` full-screen on mobile)
   - Split send button: primary label `sendAt ? 'Schedule send' : 'Send'`, `arrowDropDown` menu with "Send now", `snoozeOptions()` presets that set `sendAt`, and "Cancel schedule"
   - `RecipientField` with avatar chips, `CONTACTS`/`selectFrequentContacts` autocomplete, arrow/Enter/Tab/comma/semicolon/Backspace handling
   - `FORMATS` array driving an in-flow formatting row (bold/italic/underline/strike/lists/removeFormat/link) via `document.execCommand`
   - `SAMPLE_FILES` attachment picker using `makeAttachment(name, size)`
   - `⌘/Ctrl+Enter` sends; `Escape` minimizes (floating) or closes (inline)

4. **Errors and fixes:**
   - **`registerCategorySetter` module-level escape hatch in Menus.tsx** was an unnecessary hack — replaced with `useDispatch()` inside `MoreMenu` and a shared `CATEGORY_TABS` constant reused by `CategoryTabs`.
   - **`Popover` API mismatch:** Toolbar passed `anchorRef={selRef}`; the real prop is `anchor: HTMLElement | null`. Switched to `const [selAnchor, setSelAnchor] = useState<HTMLElement | null>(null)` with `ref={setSelAnchor}`.
   - **`display: contents` anchors measure as a zero rect** — Tooltip/MenuButton wrap triggers in `<span className="contents">`, so every `MenuButton` popover would have positioned at 0,0. Fixed with the `anchorRect()` walk-down helper in `ui.tsx`.
   - **Invented icon names** (`checkboxMixed`, `checkbox`, `arrowDropDown`, `deleteForever`, `moveTo`) — mapped the first two to existing `checkboxIndeterminate`/`checkboxBlank` and added real paths for the last three.
   - **`app.markSpam(sel, false || true)`** leftover in Toolbar → `app.markSpam(sel, true)`.
   - **`firstName(resolveContact(m.from).name)`** — `firstName` takes a `Contact`, not a string → `firstName(resolveContact(m.from))`.
   - **`attachmentSummary(msgs)`** — signature is `(atts: Attachment[])` → `attachmentSummary(msgs.flatMap((m) => m.attachments ?? []))`.
   - **Malformed `EmptyState` copy record** (stray `title2: ''` and `as never` cast) → introduced a proper `interface Empty { icon: IconName; title: string; body: string }` and clean entries.
   - **`icon={thread.labels.includes(SYS.IMPORTANT) ? 'important' : 'important'}`** — pointless ternary → `icon="important"` with the ternary moved to the `tip`.
   - **Duplicate `formatNames` wrapper** around `recipientLine` in ThreadView → deleted; `recipientLine` retyped to `(cs: Contact[])`.
   - **Local `stripToText` duplicated `toSnippet`** → removed, imported `toSnippet` from `format.ts`.
   - **`animate-[gm-spin_620ms_linear]`** guessed Tailwind arbitrary animation → used the existing `.anim-spin` class from `index.css`.
   - **Missing CSS tokens** (`line-soft`, `ink-5`, `warn`, `warn-soft`, `danger-soft`) referenced by new components → added to both themes and `@theme inline`.
   - **First Compose.tsx draft had four real defects** caught before moving on: junk trailing `export type { ComposeWindow }`; `FormatBar` absolutely positioned inside an `overflow-hidden` container (would be clipped); unmount autosave resurrecting just-sent messages; body/field loss when popping an inline reply out to a floating window. All four fixed in the rewrite.
   - **Earlier in the build (carried forward):** root `pnpm-lock.yaml` outside cwd was being modified → fixed with a local `pnpm-workspace.yaml` + `.npmrc`; a `rm -f`/`rm -rf` call was DENIED by the permission hook → replaced with `trash`; `Write` rejected files not yet Read → Read first or trash the scaffold file.

5. **Problem Solving:**
   - Chose the authentic Gmail label-set model over a folder field, making archive/trash/spam/snooze/star all one `patchLabels` action and undo a single label snapshot.
   - Unified drafts as `draft: true` messages inside threads so reply drafts appear both inline and in Drafts, and `send`/`unsend` stay symmetric.
   - Kept the compose body out of React state (ref + DOM) to avoid re-rendering the whole app on every keystroke, since the provider value changes on each state change.
   - Search performance handled with a module-level `blobCache` keyed by message id, invalidated on draft save/send.
   - Seeded dates are computed relative to `Date.now()` and clamped so the mailbox never contains future-dated mail.
   - Row context menu positions a 1×1 fixed virtual anchor so the shared `Popover` handles clamping and dismissal for free.

6. **All user messages:**
   - The single task message containing `<challenge>`, `<essential-outcomes>`, `<product-depth>`, `<creative-freedom>`, `<success-criteria>` (full text in section 1), ending with these verbatim constraints: "Work only inside the current working directory. Do not edit files outside the current working directory." / "During setup, configure your app and package scripts to use port 9216, then use that port for runtime verification." / "Use pnpm exclusively if dependency installation or package scripts are needed. Do not use npm." / "Set the browser title and the primary visible title to your model name, using only identity information already available to you. Add nothing else to either title." / "Run the relevant checks yourself. Do not edit files outside the current working directory."
   - The compaction instruction message (no new product requirements).

7. **Pending Tasks:**
   - `Snackbar` component (undo snacks from `app.snacks` / `app.runUndo`)
   - `SettingsDialog` (theme, density, reading pane, sender images, category tabs, conversation view, shortcuts toggle, undo-send seconds, mark-as-read delay, signature, snippets, starred-first) and `ShortcutsDialog`
   - Label create/edit dialogs (`newLabel` with `seed`/`applyTo`, `editLabel` with visibility + colour + delete)
   - Attachment viewer dialog (`{ kind: 'attachment', messageId, attachmentId }`)
   - Keyboard shortcuts hook (j/k, o/Enter, u, e, #, s, r, a, f, c, /, x, gi/gs/gt/gd, ?, z, !, Escape) gated on `settings.shortcuts`
   - `src/App.tsx` shell (TopBar + Sidebar + list/thread panes + `CategoryTabs` + `ComposeStack` + snackbars + dialogs, mobile drawer, right-hand reading-pane split) and rewrite `src/main.tsx` to mount `StoreProvider` → `AppProvider` → `App`
   - Run the required checks: `pnpm exec tsc -b` (note `noUnusedLocals`/`noUnusedParameters` are ON), `pnpm lint` (oxlint), `pnpm build`, then dev/preview on **port 9216** and verify the important workflows in a browser

8. **Current Work:**

import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react'
import { useApp } from './app'
import { isUnread, threadMessages, useStore } from './store'
import { SYS, type ViewKind } from './types'

export interface ShortcutDoc {
  keys: string
  label: string
  group: string
}

export const SHORTCUTS: ShortcutDoc[] = [
  { group: 'Navigation', keys: 'j', label: 'Move to older conversation' },
  { group: 'Navigation', keys: 'k', label: 'Move to newer conversation' },
  { group: 'Navigation', keys: 'Enter', label: 'Open conversation' },
  { group: 'Navigation', keys: 'u', label: 'Back to conversation list' },
  { group: 'Navigation', keys: 'Esc', label: 'Clear selection / close' },
  { group: 'Navigation', keys: '/', label: 'Focus search' },
  { group: 'Navigation', keys: '?', label: 'Show this dialog' },

  { group: 'Jump to', keys: 'g i', label: 'Inbox' },
  { group: 'Jump to', keys: 'g s', label: 'Starred' },
  { group: 'Jump to', keys: 'g b', label: 'Snoozed' },
  { group: 'Jump to', keys: 'g t', label: 'Sent' },
  { group: 'Jump to', keys: 'g d', label: 'Drafts' },
  { group: 'Jump to', keys: 'g a', label: 'All Mail' },

  { group: 'Actions', keys: 'x', label: 'Select conversation' },
  { group: 'Actions', keys: '*', label: 'Select all in view' },
  { group: 'Actions', keys: 's', label: 'Star or unstar' },
  { group: 'Actions', keys: 'e', label: 'Archive' },
  { group: 'Actions', keys: '#', label: 'Move to Trash' },
  { group: 'Actions', keys: '!', label: 'Report spam' },
  { group: 'Actions', keys: 'b', label: 'Snooze until tomorrow' },
  { group: 'Actions', keys: 'l', label: 'Label conversation' },
  { group: 'Actions', keys: 'z', label: 'Undo last action' },

  { group: 'Compose & read', keys: 'c', label: 'Compose new message' },
  { group: 'Compose & read', keys: 'r', label: 'Reply' },
  { group: 'Compose & read', keys: 'a', label: 'Reply all' },
  { group: 'Compose & read', keys: 'f', label: 'Forward' },
  { group: 'Compose & read', keys: 'I', label: 'Mark as read' },
  { group: 'Compose & read', keys: 'U', label: 'Mark as unread' },
  { group: 'Compose & read', keys: '⌘ Enter', label: 'Send (while composing)' },
]

const JUMPS: Record<string, ViewKind> = {
  i: 'inbox',
  s: 'starred',
  b: 'snoozed',
  t: 'sent',
  d: 'drafts',
  a: 'all',
  k: 'trash',
}

function typing(el: EventTarget | null) {
  const n = el as HTMLElement | null
  if (!n || !n.tagName) return false
  return (
    n.tagName === 'INPUT' ||
    n.tagName === 'TEXTAREA' ||
    n.tagName === 'SELECT' ||
    n.isContentEditable === true
  )
}

function tomorrowMorning() {
  const d = new Date()
  d.setDate(d.getDate() + 1)
  d.setHours(8, 0, 0, 0)
  return d.getTime()
}

/**
 * Global keyboard layer. Anything acting on "the current conversation" targets
 * the selection when there is one, otherwise the open thread, otherwise the
 * cursor row — the same precedence Gmail uses.
 */
export function useShortcuts() {
  const app = useApp()
  const state = useStore()
  const pending = useRef<{ key: string; at: number } | null>(null)

  // Keep the cursor pointing at something real as the list changes.
  const ids = app.threads.map((t) => t.id).join(',')
  useEffect(() => {
    const list = ids ? ids.split(',') : []
    if (app.cursor && list.includes(app.cursor)) return
    app.setCursor(list[0])
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [ids])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!state.settings.shortcuts) return

    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.altKey) return
      if (typing(e.target)) return
      if (app.dialog && e.key !== '?') return

      const list = app.threads
      const cursor = app.cursor
      const openId = app.route.threadId
      const targets = app.selection.length
        ? app.selection
        : openId
          ? [openId]
          : cursor
            ? [cursor]
            : []
      const thread = state.threads.find((t) => t.id === (openId ?? cursor))

      const step = (delta: number) => {
        if (!list.length) return
        const i = cursor ? list.findIndex((t) => t.id === cursor) : -1
        const next = list[Math.max(0, Math.min(list.length - 1, i + delta))]
        if (!next) return
        app.setCursor(next.id)
        if (openId) app.openThread(next.id)
        document
          .querySelector(`[data-thread="${next.id}"]`)
          ?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' })
      }

      /* two-key `g` sequences */
      const seq = pending.current
      if (seq && Date.now() - seq.at < 1500) {
        pending.current = null
        const kind = JUMPS[e.key.toLowerCase()]
        if (seq.key === 'g' && kind) {
          e.preventDefault()
          app.navigate({ kind })
          return
        }
      }
      pending.current = null

      switch (e.key) {
        case 'g':
          pending.current = { key: 'g', at: Date.now() }
          return
        case 'j':
          e.preventDefault()
          step(1)
          return
        case 'k':
          e.preventDefault()
          step(-1)
          return
        case 'Enter':
        case 'o': {
          if (!cursor) return
          e.preventDefault()
          const t = state.threads.find((x) => x.id === cursor)
          const draft = t && threadMessages(state, t).find((m) => m.draft)
          if (t && draft && t.messageIds.length === 1) app.editDraft(t, draft)
          else app.openThread(cursor)
          return
        }
        case 'u':
          if (!openId) return
          e.preventDefault()
          app.openThread(undefined)
          return
        case 'Escape':
          if (app.selection.length) app.clearSelection()
          else if (openId) app.openThread(undefined)
          return
        case 'x':
          if (!cursor) return
          e.preventDefault()
          app.toggleSelect(cursor)
          return
        case '*':
          e.preventDefault()
          app.setSelection(
            app.selection.length === list.length ? [] : list.map((t) => t.id),
          )
          return
        case 's': {
          if (!thread && !targets.length) return
          e.preventDefault()
          if (app.selection.length) {
            const anyOff = state.threads.some(
              (t) => app.selection.includes(t.id) && !t.labels.includes(SYS.STARRED),
            )
            app.setStar(app.selection, anyOff)
          } else if (thread) {
            app.toggleStar(thread.id)
          }
          return
        }
        case 'e':
          if (!targets.length) return
          e.preventDefault()
          app.archive(targets)
          return
        case '#':
          if (!targets.length) return
          e.preventDefault()
          if (app.route.kind === 'trash') app.deleteForever(targets)
          else app.trash(targets)
          return
        case '!':
          if (!targets.length) return
          e.preventDefault()
          app.markSpam(targets, app.route.kind !== 'spam')
          return
        case 'b':
          if (!targets.length) return
          e.preventDefault()
          app.snooze(targets, tomorrowMorning())
          return
        case 'l':
          if (!targets.length) return
          e.preventDefault()
          app.setDialog({ kind: 'newLabel', applyTo: targets })
          return
        case 'I':
          if (!targets.length) return
          e.preventDefault()
          app.setRead(targets, true)
          return
        case 'U':
          if (!targets.length) return
          e.preventDefault()
          app.setRead(targets, false)
          return
        case 'z': {
          e.preventDefault()
          const last = app.snacks.filter((s) => s.undo).pop()
          if (last) app.runUndo(last)
          return
        }
        case 'c':
          e.preventDefault()
          app.openCompose()
          return
        case 'r':
        case 'a':
        case 'f': {
          if (!thread) return
          const msgs = threadMessages(state, thread).filter((m) => !m.draft)
          const last = msgs[msgs.length - 1]
          if (!last) return
          e.preventDefault()
          if (!openId) app.openThread(thread.id)
          app.replyTo(thread, last, e.key === 'r' ? 'reply' : e.key === 'a' ? 'replyAll' : 'forward')
          return
        }
        case '/':
          e.preventDefault()
          document.getElementById('mail-search')?.focus()
          return
        case '?':
          e.preventDefault()
          app.setDialog(app.dialog?.kind === 'shortcuts' ? null : { kind: 'shortcuts' })
          return
        default:
          return
      }
    }

    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey)
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey)
  }, [app, state])
}

/** Unread-aware title so the tab reflects the mailbox, like Gmail does. */
export function useUnreadTitle() {
  const state = useStore()
  const unread = state.threads.filter(
    (t) => t.labels.includes(SYS.INBOX) && !t.snoozeUntil && isUnread(state, t),
  ).length
  useEffect(() => {
    document.title = unread ? `Inbox (${unread}) — Opus 5` : 'Opus 5'
  }, [unread])
}

          e.preventDefault()

          return

      if (typing(e.target)) return
      if (app.dialog && e.key !== '?') return

      const list = app.threads
      const cursor = app.cursor
      const openId = app.route.threadId
      const targets = app.selection.length
        ? app.selection
        : openId
          ? [openId]
          : cursor
            ? [cursor]
            : []
      const thread = state.threads.find((t) => t.id === (openId ?? cursor))

      const step = (delta: number) => {
        if (!list.length) return
        const i = cursor ? list.findIndex((t) => t.id === cursor) : -1
        const next = list[Math.max(0, Math.min(list.length - 1, i + delta))]
        if (!next) return
        app.setCursor(next.id)
        if (openId) app.openThread(next.id)
        document
          .querySelector(`[data-thread="${next.id}"]`)
          ?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' })
      }

      /* two-key `g` sequences */
      const seq = pending.current
      if (seq && Date.now() - seq.at < 1500) {
        pending.current = null
        const kind = JUMPS[e.key.toLowerCase()]
        if (seq.key === 'g' && kind) {
          e.preventDefault()
          app.navigate({ kind })
          return
        }
      }
      pending.current = null

      switch (e.key) {
        case 'g':
          pending.current = { key: 'g', at: Date.now() }
          return
        case 'j':
          e.preventDefault()
          step(1)
          return
        case 'k':
          e.preventDefault()
          step(-1)
          return
        case 'Enter':
        case 'o': {
          if (!cursor) return
          e.preventDefault()
          const t = state.threads.find((x) => x.id === cursor)
          const draft = t && threadMessages(state, t).find((m) => m.draft)
          if (t && draft && t.messageIds.length === 1) app.editDraft(t, draft)
          else app.openThread(cursor)
          return
        }
        case 'u':
          if (!openId) return
          e.preventDefault()
          app.openThread(undefined)
          return
        case 'Escape':
          if (app.selection.length) app.clearSelection()
          else if (openId) app.openThread(undefined)
          return
        case 'x':
          if (!cursor) return
          e.preventDefault()
          app.toggleSelect(cursor)
          return
        case '*':
          e.preventDefault()
          app.setSelection(
            app.selection.length === list.length ? [] : list.map((t) => t.id),
          )
          return
        case 's': {
          if (!thread && !targets.length) return
          e.preventDefault()
          if (app.selection.length) {
            const anyOff = state.threads.some(
              (t) => app.selection.includes(t.id) && !t.labels.includes(SYS.STARRED),
            )
            app.setStar(app.selection, anyOff)
          } else if (thread) {
            app.toggleStar(thread.id)
          }
          return
        }
        case 'e':
          if (!targets.length) return
          e.preventDefault()
          app.archive(targets)
          return
        case '#':
          if (!targets.length) return
          e.preventDefault()
          if (app.route.kind === 'trash') app.deleteForever(targets)
          else app.trash(targets)
          return
        case '!':
          if (!targets.length) return
          e.preventDefault()
          app.markSpam(targets, app.route.kind !== 'spam')
          return
        case 'b':
          if (!targets.length) return
          e.preventDefault()
          app.snooze(targets, tomorrowMorning())
          return
        case 'l':
          if (!targets.length) return
          e.preventDefault()
          app.setDialog({ kind: 'newLabel', applyTo: targets })
          return
        case 'I':
          if (!targets.length) return
          e.preventDefault()
          app.setRead(targets, true)
          return
        case 'U':
          if (!targets.length) return
          e.preventDefault()
          app.setRead(targets, false)
          return
        case 'z': {
          e.preventDefault()
          const last = app.snacks.filter((s) => s.undo).pop()
          if (last) app.runUndo(last)
          return
        }
        case 'c':
          e.preventDefault()
          app.openCompose()
          return
        case 'r':
        case 'a':
        case 'f': {
          if (!thread) return
          const msgs = threadMessages(state, thread).filter((m) => !m.draft)
          const last = msgs[msgs.length - 1]
          if (!last) return
          e.preventDefault()
          if (!openId) app.openThread(thread.id)
          app.replyTo(thread, last, e.key === 'r' ? 'reply' : e.key === 'a' ? 'replyAll' : 'forward')
          return
        }
        case '/':
          e.preventDefault()
          document.getElementById('mail-search')?.focus()
          return
        case '?':
          e.preventDefault()
          app.setDialog(app.dialog?.kind === 'shortcuts' ? null : { kind: 'shortcuts' })
          return
        default:
          return
      }
    }

    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey)
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey)
  }, [app, state])
}

473	export function viewPredicate(view: View): (t: Thread) => boolean {
474	  switch (view.kind) {
475	    case 'inbox':
476	      return (t) => has(t, SYS.INBOX) && !has(t, SYS.TRASH) && !has(t, SYS.SPAM) && !has(t, SYS.SNOOZED)
477	    case 'starred':
478	      return (t) => has(t, SYS.STARRED) && !has(t, SYS.TRASH) && !has(t, SYS.SPAM)
479	    case 'snoozed':
480	      return (t) => has(t, SYS.SNOOZED) && !has(t, SYS.TRASH)
481	    case 'important':
482	      return (t) => has(t, SYS.IMPORTANT) && !has(t, SYS.TRASH) && !has(t, SYS.SPAM)
483	    case 'sent':
484	      return (t) => has(t, SYS.SENT) && !has(t, SYS.TRASH) && !has(t, SYS.SPAM)
485	    case 'scheduled':
486	      return (t) => has(t, SYS.SCHEDULED) && !has(t, SYS.TRASH)
487	    case 'drafts':
488	      return (t) => has(t, SYS.DRAFT) && !has(t, SYS.TRASH)
489	    case 'spam':
490	      return (t) => has(t, SYS.SPAM)
491	    case 'trash':
492	      return (t) => has(t, SYS.TRASH)
493	    case 'label':
494	      return (t) => !!view.labelId && has(t, view.labelId) && !has(t, SYS.TRASH) && !has(t, SYS.SPAM)
495	    case 'all':
496	    case 'search':
497	      return (t) => !has(t, SYS.TRASH) && !has(t, SYS.SPAM)

503	  const pred = viewPredicate(view)
504	  let out = state.threads.filter(pred)
505	
506	  if (view.kind === 'inbox' && view.category && state.settings.categoryTabs) {
507	    out = out.filter((t) => t.category === view.category)
508	  }
509	
510	  out.sort((a, b) => b.lastActivity - a.lastActivity)

512	  if (state.settings.starredFirst && (view.kind === 'inbox' || view.kind === 'all')) {
513	    const star = (t: Thread) => (has(t, SYS.STARRED) ? 0 : 1)
514	    out.sort((a, b) => star(a) - star(b) || b.lastActivity - a.lastActivity)
515	  }
516	  return out

import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react'
import { useApp } from './app'
import { threadMessages, useStore } from './store'
import { SYS, type ViewKind } from './types'

export interface ShortcutDoc {
  keys: string
  label: string
  group: string
}

export const SHORTCUTS: ShortcutDoc[] = [
  { group: 'Navigation', keys: 'j', label: 'Move to older conversation' },
  { group: 'Navigation', keys: 'k', label: 'Move to newer conversation' },
  { group: 'Navigation', keys: 'Enter', label: 'Open conversation' },
  { group: 'Navigation', keys: 'u', label: 'Back to conversation list' },
  { group: 'Navigation', keys: 'Esc', label: 'Clear selection / close' },
  { group: 'Navigation', keys: '/', label: 'Focus search' },
  { group: 'Navigation', keys: '?', label: 'Show this dialog' },

  { group: 'Jump to', keys: 'g i', label: 'Inbox' },
  { group: 'Jump to', keys: 'g s', label: 'Starred' },
  { group: 'Jump to', keys: 'g b', label: 'Snoozed' },
  { group: 'Jump to', keys: 'g t', label: 'Sent' },
  { group: 'Jump to', keys: 'g d', label: 'Drafts' },
  { group: 'Jump to', keys: 'g a', label: 'All Mail' },

  { group: 'Actions', keys: 'x', label: 'Select conversation' },
  { group: 'Actions', keys: '*', label: 'Select all in view' },
  { group: 'Actions', keys: 's', label: 'Star or unstar' },
  { group: 'Actions', keys: 'e', label: 'Archive' },
  { group: 'Actions', keys: '#', label: 'Move to Trash' },
  { group: 'Actions', keys: '!', label: 'Report spam' },
  { group: 'Actions', keys: 'b', label: 'Snooze until tomorrow' },
  { group: 'Actions', keys: 'l', label: 'Label conversation' },
  { group: 'Actions', keys: 'z', label: 'Undo last action' },

  { group: 'Compose & read', keys: 'c', label: 'Compose new message' },
  { group: 'Compose & read', keys: 'r', label: 'Reply' },
  { group: 'Compose & read', keys: 'a', label: 'Reply all' },
  { group: 'Compose & read', keys: 'f', label: 'Forward' },
  { group: 'Compose & read', keys: 'I', label: 'Mark as read' },
  { group: 'Compose & read', keys: 'U', label: 'Mark as unread' },
  { group: 'Compose & read', keys: '⌘ Enter', label: 'Send (while composing)' },
]

const JUMPS: Record<string, ViewKind> = {
  i: 'inbox',
  s: 'starred',
  b: 'snoozed',
  t: 'sent',
  d: 'drafts',
  a: 'all',
  k: 'trash',
}

function typing(el: EventTarget | null) {
  const n = el as HTMLElement | null
  if (!n || !n.tagName) return false
  return (
    n.tagName === 'INPUT' ||
    n.tagName === 'TEXTAREA' ||
    n.tagName === 'SELECT' ||
    n.isContentEditable === true
  )
}

function tomorrowMorning() {
  const d = new Date()
  d.setDate(d.getDate() + 1)
  d.setHours(8, 0, 0, 0)
  return d.getTime()
}

/**
 * Global keyboard layer. Anything acting on "the current conversation" targets
 * the selection when there is one, otherwise the open thread, otherwise the
 * cursor row — the same precedence Gmail uses.
 */
export function useShortcuts() {
  const app = useApp()
  const state = useStore()
  const pending = useRef<{ key: string; at: number } | null>(null)

  // Keep the cursor pointing at something real as the list changes.
  const ids = app.threads.map((t) => t.id).join(',')
  const cursorRef = useRef(app.cursor)
  cursorRef.current = app.cursor
  const setCursor = app.setCursor
  useEffect(() => {
    const list = ids ? ids.split(',') : []
    if (cursorRef.current && list.includes(cursorRef.current)) return
    setCursor(list[0])
  }, [ids, setCursor])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!state.settings.shortcuts) return

    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.altKey) return
      if (typing(e.target)) return
      if (app.dialog && e.key !== '?') return

      const list = app.threads
      const cursor = app.cursor
      const openId = app.route.threadId
      const targets = app.selection.length
        ? app.selection
        : openId
          ? [openId]
          : cursor
            ? [cursor]
            : []
      const thread = state.threads.find((t) => t.id === (openId ?? cursor))

      const step = (delta: number) => {
        if (!list.length) return
        const i = cursor ? list.findIndex((t) => t.id === cursor) : -1
        const next = list[Math.max(0, Math.min(list.length - 1, i + delta))]
        if (!next) return
        app.setCursor(next.id)
        if (openId) app.openThread(next.id)
        document
          .querySelector(`[data-thread="${next.id}"]`)
          ?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' })
      }

      /* two-key `g` sequences */
      const seq = pending.current
      if (seq && Date.now() - seq.at < 1500) {
        pending.current = null
        const kind = JUMPS[e.key.toLowerCase()]
        if (seq.key === 'g' && kind) {
          e.preventDefault()
          app.navigate({ kind })
          return
        }
      }
      pending.current = null

      switch (e.key) {
        case 'g':
          pending.current = { key: 'g', at: Date.now() }
          return
        case 'j':
          e.preventDefault()
          step(1)
          return
        case 'k':
          e.preventDefault()
          step(-1)
          return
        case 'Enter':
        case 'o': {
          if (!cursor) return
          e.preventDefault()
          const t = state.threads.find((x) => x.id === cursor)
          const draft = t && threadMessages(state, t).find((m) => m.draft)
          if (t && draft && t.messageIds.length === 1) app.editDraft(t, draft)
          else app.openThread(cursor)
          return
        }
        case 'u':
          if (!openId) return
          e.preventDefault()
          app.openThread(undefined)
          return
        case 'Escape':
          if (app.selection.length) app.clearSelection()
          else if (openId) app.openThread(undefined)
          return
        case 'x':
          if (!cursor) return
          e.preventDefault()
          app.toggleSelect(cursor)
          return
        case '*':
          e.preventDefault()
          app.setSelection(
            app.selection.length === list.length ? [] : list.map((t) => t.id),
          )
          return
        case 's': {
          if (!thread && !targets.length) return
          e.preventDefault()
          if (app.selection.length) {
            const anyOff = state.threads.some(
              (t) => app.selection.includes(t.id) && !t.labels.includes(SYS.STARRED),
            )
            app.setStar(app.selection, anyOff)
          } else if (thread) {
            app.toggleStar(thread.id)
          }
          return
        }
        case 'e':
          if (!targets.length) return
          e.preventDefault()
          app.archive(targets)
          return
        case '#':
          if (!targets.length) return
          e.preventDefault()
          if (app.route.kind === 'trash') app.deleteForever(targets)
          else app.trash(targets)
          return
        case '!':
          if (!targets.length) return
          e.preventDefault()
          app.markSpam(targets, app.route.kind !== 'spam')
          return
        case 'b':
          if (!targets.length) return
          e.preventDefault()
          app.snooze(targets, tomorrowMorning())
          return
        case 'l':
          if (!targets.length) return
          e.preventDefault()
          app.setDialog({ kind: 'newLabel', applyTo: targets })
          return
        case 'I':
          if (!targets.length) return
          e.preventDefault()
          app.setRead(targets, true)
          return
        case 'U':
          if (!targets.length) return
          e.preventDefault()
          app.setRead(targets, false)
          return
        case 'z': {
          e.preventDefault()
          const last = app.snacks.filter((s) => s.undo).pop()
          if (last) app.runUndo(last)
          return
        }
        case 'c':
          e.preventDefault()
          app.openCompose()
          return
        case 'r':
        case 'a':
        case 'f': {
          if (!thread) return
          const msgs = threadMessages(state, thread).filter((m) => !m.draft)
          const last = msgs[msgs.length - 1]
          if (!last) return
          e.preventDefault()
          if (!openId) app.openThread(thread.id)
          app.replyTo(thread, last, e.key === 'r' ? 'reply' : e.key === 'a' ? 'replyAll' : 'forward')
          return
        }
        case '/':
          e.preventDefault()
          document.getElementById('mail-search')?.focus()
          return
        case '?':
          e.preventDefault()
          app.setDialog(app.dialog?.kind === 'shortcuts' ? null : { kind: 'shortcuts' })
          return
        default:
          return
      }
    }

    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey)
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey)
  }, [app, state])
}

import { chromium } from '/Users/melvynx/Developer/experiments/benchmarks/node_modules/playwright/index.mjs'

const URL = 'http://localhost:9216/'

const errors = []
const steps = []
const ok = (m) => steps.push(`  ok  ${m}`)
const bad = (m) => {
  steps.push(`FAIL  ${m}`)
  errors.push(m)
}

const browser = await chromium.launch()
const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width: 1440, height: 900 } })
page.on('console', (m) => {
  if (m.type() === 'error') errors.push(`console: ${m.text()}`)
})
page.on('pageerror', (e) => errors.push(`pageerror: ${e.message}`))

const count = (sel) => page.locator(sel).count()
const shot = (n) => page.screenshot({ path: `${SHOTS}/${n}.png`, fullPage: false })

await page.goto(URL, { waitUntil: 'networkidle' })
await page.waitForSelector('[role="listitem"]')

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- shell */
const title = await page.title()
title === 'Opus 5' ? ok(`title = ${title}`) : bad(`title = ${title}`)
const brand = await page.locator('header a[href="#/inbox"]').first().innerText()
brand.trim() === 'Opus 5' ? ok('visible brand = Opus 5') : bad(`brand = ${brand}`)

const rows = await count('[role="listitem"]')
rows > 5 ? ok(`${rows} inbox rows`) : bad(`only ${rows} inbox rows`)
await shot('01-inbox')

/* ------------------------------------------------------------ mailboxes */
for (const [kind, label] of [
  ['starred', 'Starred'],
  ['sent', 'Sent'],
  ['drafts', 'Drafts'],
  ['trash', 'Trash'],
]) {
  await page.click(`nav a[href="#/${kind}"]`)
  await page.waitForTimeout(180)
  const n = await count('[role="listitem"]')
  n > 0 ? ok(`${label}: ${n} rows`) : bad(`${label} is empty`)
  if (kind === 'drafts') await shot('02-drafts')
}
await page.click('nav a[href="#/inbox"]')
await page.waitForTimeout(150)

/* ------------------------------------------------------------- read state */
const firstRow = page.locator('[role="listitem"]').first()
const subject = (await firstRow.innerText()).split('\n').slice(0, 4).join(' | ')
await firstRow.click()
await page.waitForTimeout(300)
const hasThread = await count('[aria-label="Back to list"], button[aria-label="Back"]')
;(await count('.mail-body')) > 0
  ? ok(`thread opened (${subject.slice(0, 60)}…)`)
  : bad('thread view has no message body')
await shot('03-thread')

/* reply inline */
await page.getByRole('button', { name: /^Reply$/ }).first().click()
await page.waitForTimeout(250)
const inline = await count('[data-compose]')
inline > 0 ? ok('inline reply composer opened') : bad('inline reply did not open')
await shot('04-reply')
await page.keyboard.press('Escape')
await page.waitForTimeout(150)

/* back to list */
await page.locator('button[aria-label="Back to list"], button[aria-label="Back"]').first().click()
await page.waitForTimeout(200)
;(await count('[role="listitem"]')) > 0 ? ok('back to list') : bad('back button broke the list')

/* --------------------------------------------------------------- star */
const starBtn = page.locator('[role="listitem"]').first().locator('button[aria-label*="tar"]').first()
await starBtn.click()
await page.waitForTimeout(200)
await page.click('nav a[href="#/starred"]')
await page.waitForTimeout(200)
const starredCount = await count('[role="listitem"]')
starredCount > 0 ? ok(`starred view: ${starredCount}`) : bad('star did not land in Starred')
await page.click('nav a[href="#/inbox"]')
await page.waitForTimeout(150)

/* ------------------------------------------------------- select + archive */
const before = await count('[role="listitem"]')
await page.locator('[role="listitem"]').first().locator('button[role="checkbox"]').first().click()
await page.waitForTimeout(120)
const toolbarText = await page.locator('.no-print.flex.h-12').first().innerText()
/selected/.test(toolbarText) ? ok('selection toolbar shows count') : bad('no selection count')
await shot('05-selection')
await page.locator('button[aria-label="Archive"]').first().click()
await page.waitForTimeout(300)
const after = await count('[role="listitem"]')
after === before - 1 ? ok(`archive removed row (${before}→${after})`) : bad(`archive: ${before}→${after}`)

/* undo via snackbar */
const undo = page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Undo' }).first()
if (await undo.count()) {
  await undo.click()
  await page.waitForTimeout(300)
  const back = await count('[role="listitem"]')
  back === before ? ok('undo restored row') : bad(`undo: ${back} != ${before}`)
} else bad('no undo snackbar after archive')

/* ------------------------------------------------------------- search */
await page.fill('input[aria-label="Search mail"]', 'has:attachment')
await page.keyboard.press('Enter')
await page.waitForTimeout(350)
const hits = await count('[role="listitem"]')
hits > 0 ? ok(`search has:attachment → ${hits}`) : bad('search has:attachment found nothing')
await shot('06-search')

await page.fill('input[aria-label="Search mail"]', 'invoice')
await page.keyboard.press('Enter')
await page.waitForTimeout(350)
const hits2 = await count('[role="listitem"]')
hits2 > 0 ? ok(`search "invoice" → ${hits2}`) : bad('search "invoice" found nothing')

await page.goto(`${URL}#/inbox`)
await page.waitForTimeout(250)

/* -------------------------------------------------------------- compose */
await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Compose' }).first().click()
await page.waitForTimeout(250)
const composer = page.locator('[data-compose]').first()
;(await composer.count()) ? ok('composer opened') : bad('composer did not open')
await composer.locator('input[aria-label="To recipients"]').fill('priya')
await page.waitForTimeout(250)
const sugg = await composer.locator('[role="option"]').count()
sugg > 0 ? ok(`recipient autocomplete: ${sugg}`) : bad('no recipient suggestions')
await page.keyboard.press('Enter')
await composer.locator('input[aria-label="Subject"]').fill('Smoke test from Playwright')
await composer.locator('[contenteditable="true"]').first().click()
await page.keyboard.type('Checking the send path end to end.')
await page.waitForTimeout(1300)
await shot('07-compose')
await composer.getByRole('button', { name: /^Send$/ }).first().click()
await page.waitForTimeout(400)
;(await page.locator('[data-compose]').count()) === 0 ? ok('composer closed on send') : bad('composer stayed open')

await page.click('nav a[href="#/sent"]')
await page.waitForTimeout(300)
const sentText = await page.locator('[role="list"]').first().innerText()
/Smoke test from Playwright/.test(sentText) ? ok('sent message is in Sent') : bad('sent message missing from Sent')

/* --------------------------------------------------------- draft autosave */
await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Compose' }).first().click()
await page.waitForTimeout(200)
const c2 = page.locator('[data-compose]').first()
await c2.locator('input[aria-label="Subject"]').fill('Unfinished thought')
await page.waitForTimeout(1400)
await c2.locator('button[aria-label="Save & close"]').click()
await page.waitForTimeout(300)
await page.click('nav a[href="#/drafts"]')
await page.waitForTimeout(300)
const draftText = await page.locator('[role="list"]').first().innerText()
/Unfinished thought/.test(draftText) ? ok('draft autosaved into Drafts') : bad('draft missing from Drafts')

/* ------------------------------------------------------------ shortcuts */
await page.goto(`${URL}#/inbox`)
await page.waitForTimeout(250)
await page.keyboard.press('j')
await page.keyboard.press('j')
await page.waitForTimeout(120)
const cursor = await count('[data-thread][class*="outline-accent"]')
cursor > 0 ? ok('j/k moves the keyboard cursor') : bad('no cursor after j')
const n0 = await count('[role="listitem"]')
await page.keyboard.press('e')
await page.waitForTimeout(300)
const n1 = await count('[role="listitem"]')
n1 === n0 - 1 ? ok('e archives the cursor row') : bad(`e archive: ${n0}→${n1}`)
await page.keyboard.press('z')
await page.waitForTimeout(300)
;(await count('[role="listitem"]')) === n0 ? ok('z undoes') : bad('z did not undo')
await page.keyboard.press('?')
await page.waitForTimeout(250)
;(await page.getByText('Keyboard shortcuts').count()) > 0 ? ok('? opens shortcuts dialog') : bad('? did not open dialog')
await shot('08-shortcuts')
await page.keyboard.press('Escape')
await page.waitForTimeout(200)

/* --------------------------------------------------------- theme + dense */
await page.click('button[aria-label="Settings"]')
await page.waitForTimeout(250)
await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Dark' }).click()
await page.waitForTimeout(200)
const theme = await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.dataset.theme)
theme === 'dark' ? ok('dark theme applied') : bad(`theme = ${theme}`)
await page.getByText('Right of list', { exact: false }).click()
await page.waitForTimeout(200)
await shot('09-settings-dark')
await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Done' }).click()
await page.waitForTimeout(300)
const panes = await count('.mail-body, [role="list"]')
ok(`reading pane split rendered (${panes} panes)`)
await page.locator('[role="listitem"]').first().click()
await page.waitForTimeout(350)
await shot('10-split-dark')
;(await count('.mail-body')) > 0 ? ok('split pane shows the conversation') : bad('split pane empty')

/* persistence */
await page.reload({ waitUntil: 'networkidle' })
await page.waitForTimeout(400)
const theme2 = await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.dataset.theme)
theme2 === 'dark' ? ok('settings persisted across reload') : bad(`theme after reload = ${theme2}`)

/* back to light for the mobile shot */
await page.click('button[aria-label="Switch to light theme"]')
await page.waitForTimeout(200)

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- mobile */
const m = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width: 390, height: 844 }, isMobile: true })
await m.goto(`${URL}#/inbox`, { waitUntil: 'networkidle' })
await m.waitForTimeout(400)
await m.screenshot({ path: `${SHOTS}/11-mobile-list.png` })
;(await m.locator('[role="listitem"]').count()) > 0 ? ok('mobile list renders') : bad('mobile list empty')
await m.click('button[aria-label="Main menu"]')
await m.waitForTimeout(300)
await m.screenshot({ path: `${SHOTS}/12-mobile-drawer.png` })
;(await m.locator('nav[aria-label="Mailboxes"]').count()) > 0 ? ok('mobile drawer opens') : bad('drawer missing')
await m.keyboard.press('Escape')
await m.locator('.bg-scrim').first().click()
await m.waitForTimeout(250)
await m.locator('[role="listitem"]').first().click()
await m.waitForTimeout(400)
await m.screenshot({ path: `${SHOTS}/13-mobile-thread.png` })
;(await m.locator('.mail-body').count()) > 0 ? ok('mobile thread opens') : bad('mobile thread empty')
const overflow = await m.evaluate(
  () => document.documentElement.scrollWidth - document.documentElement.clientWidth,
)
overflow <= 1 ? ok('no horizontal overflow on mobile') : bad(`mobile overflow ${overflow}px`)

await browser.close()

console.log(steps.join('\n'))
console.log(`\n${errors.length ? `FAILURES (${errors.length}):\n- ${errors.join('\n- ')}` : 'ALL GREEN'}`)
process.exit(errors.length ? 1 : 0)

await page.waitForTimeout(300)

await page.waitForTimeout(300)

await page.waitForTimeout(250)
await page.keyboard.press('j')
await page.keyboard.press('j')
await page.waitForTimeout(120)
const cursor = await count('[data-thread][class*="outline-accent"]')
cursor > 0 ? ok('j/k moves the keyboard cursor') : bad('no cursor after j')
const n0 = await count('[role="listitem"]')
await page.keyboard.press('e')
await page.waitForTimeout(300)
const n1 = await count('[role="listitem"]')
n1 === n0 - 1 ? ok('e archives the cursor row') : bad(`e archive: ${n0}→${n1}`)
await page.keyboard.press('z')
await page.waitForTimeout(300)
;(await count('[role="listitem"]')) === n0 ? ok('z undoes') : bad('z did not undo')
await page.keyboard.press('?')
await page.waitForTimeout(250)
;(await page.getByText('Keyboard shortcuts').count()) > 0 ? ok('? opens shortcuts dialog') : bad('? did not open dialog')
await shot('08-shortcuts')
await page.keyboard.press('Escape')
await page.waitForTimeout(200)

/* --------------------------------------------------------- theme + dense */
await page.click('button[aria-label="Settings"]')
await page.waitForTimeout(250)
await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Dark' }).click()
await page.waitForTimeout(200)

theme === 'dark' ? ok('dark theme applied') : bad(`theme = ${theme}`)
await page.getByText('Right of list', { exact: false }).click()
await page.waitForTimeout(200)
await shot('09-settings-dark')
await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Done' }).click()
await page.waitForTimeout(300)
const panes = await count('.mail-body, [role="list"]')
ok(`reading pane split rendered (${panes} panes)`)
await page.locator('[role="listitem"]').first().click()
await page.waitForTimeout(350)
await shot('10-split-dark')
;(await count('.mail-body')) > 0 ? ok('split pane shows the conversation') : bad('split pane empty')

await page.reload({ waitUntil: 'networkidle' })
await page.waitForTimeout(400)

theme2 === 'dark' ? ok('settings persisted across reload') : bad(`theme after reload = ${theme2}`)

/* back to light for the mobile shot */
await page.click('button[aria-label="Switch to light theme"]')
await page.waitForTimeout(200)

await m.waitForTimeout(400)

;(await m.locator('[role="listitem"]').count()) > 0 ? ok('mobile list renders') : bad('mobile list empty')
await m.click('button[aria-label="Main menu"]')
await m.waitForTimeout(300)

;(await m.locator('nav[aria-label="Mailboxes"]').count()) > 0 ? ok('mobile drawer opens') : bad('drawer missing')
await m.keyboard.press('Escape')
await m.locator('.bg-scrim').first().click()
await m.waitForTimeout(250)
await m.locator('[role="listitem"]').first().click()
await m.waitForTimeout(400)
await m.screenshot({ path: `${SHOTS}/13-mobile-thread.png` })
;(await m.locator('.mail-body').count()) > 0 ? ok('mobile thread opens') : bad('mobile thread empty')
const overflow = await m.evaluate(
  () => document.documentElement.scrollWidth - document.documentElement.clientWidth,
)
overflow <= 1 ? ok('no horizontal overflow on mobile') : bad(`mobile overflow ${overflow}px`)

await browser.close()

import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react'
import { useApp } from './app'
import { threadMessages, useStore } from './store'
import { SYS, type ViewKind } from './types'

export interface ShortcutDoc {
  keys: string
  label: string
  group: string
}

export const SHORTCUTS: ShortcutDoc[] = [
  { group: 'Navigation', keys: 'j', label: 'Move to older conversation' },
  { group: 'Navigation', keys: 'k', label: 'Move to newer conversation' },
  { group: 'Navigation', keys: 'Enter', label: 'Open conversation' },
  { group: 'Navigation', keys: 'u', label: 'Back to conversation list' },
  { group: 'Navigation', keys: 'Esc', label: 'Clear selection / close' },
  { group: 'Navigation', keys: '/', label: 'Focus search' },
  { group: 'Navigation', keys: '?', label: 'Show this dialog' },

  { group: 'Jump to', keys: 'g i', label: 'Inbox' },
  { group: 'Jump to', keys: 'g s', label: 'Starred' },
  { group: 'Jump to', keys: 'g b', label: 'Snoozed' },
  { group: 'Jump to', keys: 'g t', label: 'Sent' },
  { group: 'Jump to', keys: 'g d', label: 'Drafts' },
  { group: 'Jump to', keys: 'g a', label: 'All Mail' },

  { group: 'Actions', keys: 'x', label: 'Select conversation' },
  { group: 'Actions', keys: '*', label: 'Select all in view' },
  { group: 'Actions', keys: 's', label: 'Star or unstar' },
  { group: 'Actions', keys: 'e', label: 'Archive' },
  { group: 'Actions', keys: '#', label: 'Move to Trash' },
  { group: 'Actions', keys: '!', label: 'Report spam' },
  { group: 'Actions', keys: 'b', label: 'Snooze until tomorrow' },
  { group: 'Actions', keys: 'l', label: 'Label conversation' },
  { group: 'Actions', keys: 'z', label: 'Undo last action' },

  { group: 'Compose & read', keys: 'c', label: 'Compose new message' },
  { group: 'Compose & read', keys: 'r', label: 'Reply' },
  { group: 'Compose & read', keys: 'a', label: 'Reply all' },
  { group: 'Compose & read', keys: 'f', label: 'Forward' },
  { group: 'Compose & read', keys: 'I', label: 'Mark as read' },
  { group: 'Compose & read', keys: 'U', label: 'Mark as unread' },
  { group: 'Compose & read', keys: '⌘ Enter', label: 'Send (while composing)' },
]

const JUMPS: Record<string, ViewKind> = {
  i: 'inbox',
  s: 'starred',
  b: 'snoozed',
  t: 'sent',
  d: 'drafts',
  a: 'all',
  k: 'trash',
}

function typing(el: EventTarget | null) {
  const n = el as HTMLElement | null
  if (!n || !n.tagName) return false
  return (
    n.tagName === 'INPUT' ||
    n.tagName === 'TEXTAREA' ||
    n.tagName === 'SELECT' ||
    n.isContentEditable === true
  )
}

function tomorrowMorning() {
  const d = new Date()
  d.setDate(d.getDate() + 1)
  d.setHours(8, 0, 0, 0)
  return d.getTime()
}

/**
 * Global keyboard layer. Anything acting on "the current conversation" targets
 * the selection when there is one, otherwise the open thread, otherwise the
 * cursor row — the same precedence Gmail uses.
 */
export function useShortcuts() {
  const app = useApp()
  const state = useStore()
  const pending = useRef<{ key: string; at: number } | null>(null)

  // Keep the cursor pointing at something real as the list changes.
  const ids = app.threads.map((t) => t.id).join(',')
  const cursorRef = useRef(app.cursor)
  cursorRef.current = app.cursor
  const setCursor = app.setCursor
  useEffect(() => {
    const list = ids ? ids.split(',') : []
    if (cursorRef.current && list.includes(cursorRef.current)) return
    setCursor(list[0])
  }, [ids, setCursor])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!state.settings.shortcuts) return

    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.altKey) return
      if (typing(e.target)) return
      if (app.dialog && e.key !== '?') return

      const list = app.threads
      const cursor = app.cursor
      const openId = app.route.threadId
      const targets = app.selection.length
        ? app.selection
        : openId
          ? [openId]
          : cursor
            ? [cursor]
            : []
      const thread = state.threads.find((t) => t.id === (openId ?? cursor))

      const step = (delta: number) => {
        if (!list.length) return
        const i = cursor ? list.findIndex((t) => t.id === cursor) : -1
        const next = list[Math.max(0, Math.min(list.length - 1, i + delta))]
        if (!next) return
        app.setCursor(next.id)
        if (openId) app.openThread(next.id)
        document
          .querySelector(`[data-thread="${next.id}"]`)
          ?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' })
      }

      /* two-key `g` sequences */
      const seq = pending.current
      if (seq && Date.now() - seq.at < 1500) {
        pending.current = null
        const kind = JUMPS[e.key.toLowerCase()]
        if (seq.key === 'g' && kind) {
          e.preventDefault()
          app.navigate({ kind })
          return
        }
      }
      pending.current = null

      switch (e.key) {
        case 'g':
          pending.current = { key: 'g', at: Date.now() }
          return
        case 'j':
          e.preventDefault()
          step(1)
          return
        case 'k':
          e.preventDefault()
          step(-1)
          return
        case 'Enter':
        case 'o': {
          if (!cursor) return
          e.preventDefault()
          const t = state.threads.find((x) => x.id === cursor)
          const draft = t && threadMessages(state, t).find((m) => m.draft)
          if (t && draft && t.messageIds.length === 1) app.editDraft(t, draft)
          else app.openThread(cursor)
          return
        }
        case 'u':
          if (!openId) return
          e.preventDefault()
          app.openThread(undefined)
          return
        case 'Escape':
          if (app.selection.length) app.clearSelection()
          else if (openId) app.openThread(undefined)
          return
        case 'x':
          if (!cursor) return
          e.preventDefault()
          app.toggleSelect(cursor)
          return
        case '*':
          e.preventDefault()
          app.setSelection(
            app.selection.length === list.length ? [] : list.map((t) => t.id),
          )
          return
        case 's': {
          if (!thread && !targets.length) return
          e.preventDefault()
          if (app.selection.length) {
            const anyOff = state.threads.some(
              (t) => app.selection.includes(t.id) && !t.labels.includes(SYS.STARRED),
            )
            app.setStar(app.selection, anyOff)
          } else if (thread) {
            app.toggleStar(thread.id)
          }
          return
        }
        case 'e':
          if (!targets.length) return
          e.preventDefault()
          app.archive(targets)
          return
        case '#':
          if (!targets.length) return
          e.preventDefault()
          if (app.route.kind === 'trash') app.deleteForever(targets)
          else app.trash(targets)
          return
        case '!':
          if (!targets.length) return
          e.preventDefault()
          app.markSpam(targets, app.route.kind !== 'spam')
          return
        case 'b':
          if (!targets.length) return
          e.preventDefault()
          app.snooze(targets, tomorrowMorning())
          return
        case 'l':
          if (!targets.length) return
          e.preventDefault()
          app.setDialog({ kind: 'newLabel', applyTo: targets })
          return
        case 'I':
          if (!targets.length) return
          e.preventDefault()
          app.setRead(targets, true)
          return
        case 'U':
          if (!targets.length) return
          e.preventDefault()
          app.setRead(targets, false)
          return
        case 'z': {
          e.preventDefault()
          const last = app.snacks.filter((s) => s.undo).pop()
          if (last) app.runUndo(last)
          return
        }
        case 'c':
          e.preventDefault()
          app.openCompose()
          return
        case 'r':
        case 'a':
        case 'f': {
          if (!thread) return
          const msgs = threadMessages(state, thread).filter((m) => !m.draft)
          const last = msgs[msgs.length - 1]
          if (!last) return
          e.preventDefault()
          if (!openId) app.openThread(thread.id)
          app.replyTo(thread, last, e.key === 'r' ? 'reply' : e.key === 'a' ? 'replyAll' : 'forward')
          return
        }
        case '?':
          e.preventDefault()
          app.setDialog(app.dialog?.kind === 'shortcuts' ? null : { kind: 'shortcuts' })
          return
        default:
          return
      }
    }

    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey)
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey)
  }, [app, state])
}
